description: Seed evaluation set. 'real' = genuine, correctly cited papers; 'corrupted' = genuine papers cited with wrong details (the AI 'right paper, wrong metadata' failure); 'fabricated' = invented citations. Extend it to ~50 entries with your own examples, keeping real papers that you have checked yourself.
